messages:
Lina (Finance): Heads-up: Vendor Mosaic Analytics submitted invoice INV-2026-498 for €9,750. AP flagged 'no PO' and a currency mismatch (EUR vs our preferred USD). Invoice here: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-498.pdf Due 2026-03-20.
Jules (AP): Thanks. Can you confirm if there was a PO at all? Our supplier onboarding shows two small POs earlier this quarter but amounts don't match.
Anik (Procurement): There are two POs: PO-4710-SW for €5,000 (licenses) and PO-4711-SVC for €4,750 (integration services). Finance asked us to split them to separate GL codes back in Feb. Seems vendor billed one consolidated invoice.
Lina (Finance): Ah ok. AP workflow requires a single PO reference. Approvals Bot gave: "multiple PO candidates".
Approvals Bot: Invoice INV-2026-498 shows amounts that can map to PO-4710-SW and PO-4711-SVC. No single PO matches full total. Please attach PO references or approve manual PO-pairing.
Jules (AP): Vendor didn't include either PO on PDF. Can procurement confirm both POs and who should approve? Also, system currency is USD so AP is asking whether to record as EUR with FX or reject until clarified.
Sam (Sourcing): I contacted Mosaic. They said they intentionally sent consolidated invoice to simplify for them. They're willing to reissue separate invoices but need a PO reference for each. They also offered a 2% early-payment discount if we process before 2026-03-15.
Anik (Procurement): Approvers: PO-4710 -> Anik (Procurement lead), PO-4711 -> Priya (Eng Ops) but Priya is OOO until 2026-03-12. Can Priya delegate to Sam? @Delegation Bot can set temporary delegate.
Delegation Bot: Priya has delegation to Sam for PO approvals from 2026-03-05 to 2026-03-12. Delegate in place.
Jules (AP): OK, if Procurement confirms PO mapping in metadata I can attach both POs manually and route to approvers. Currency: I'll record as EUR and AP will run FX at payment time unless Finance instructs otherwise.
Lina (Finance): Please record EUR with FX. Also, we should evaluate early-pay discount: 2% of €9,750 = €195 savings. Given cash position, finance prefers to take discount if approvals can clear by 03-15.
Anik (Procurement): I'm approving PO-4710 now. Sam, can you approve PO-4711 on behalf of Priya?
Sam (Sourcing): Approved PO-4711. :white_check_mark: Confirming mapping: PO-4710-SW -> licenses €5,000, PO-4711-SVC -> services €4,750.
Jules (AP): Manually attached PO-4710-SW and PO-4711-SVC to INV-2026-498 in AP system, added note about consolidated vendor invoice and early pay discount. Routing complete.
Approvals Bot: Invoice INV-2026-498 now linked to PO-4710-SW and PO-4711-SVC. Routing: Anik -> Sam (delegate) -> complete. Ready for payment approval.
Lina (Finance): Authorizing payment with early-pay discount applied. Net pay €9,555 after 2% discount. Schedule payment run 2026-03-14 to capture discount.
Jules (AP): Payment queued for 2026-03-14. Will mark as early-pay. Please confirm final GLs: PO-4710 -> 5401, PO-4711 -> 5408?
Anik (Procurement): Correct GLs.
Lina (Finance): Confirmed. Closing thread once payment posts.
Jules (AP): Payment posted 2026-03-14, vendor paid €9,555. AP note: applied FX rate 1.10 USD/EUR for reporting.
Lina (Finance): Recorded in ledger, discount captured. Thanks everyone. :tada:
notes: Vendor consolidated two POs into one invoice; procurement confirmed PO split; delegation used for OOO approver; AP attached both POs manually; early-pay discount accepted and payment scheduled and executed.
